text: {"summary": "Cluster 'goat' has 2 workloads (default/debug-shell and prod/DaemonSet/node-agent) running privileged with hostPath mounts, which gives a likely path to node compromise. debug-shell also carries a HIGH openssl CVE and has several hardening gaps. NSA score is 38.0 and MITRE is 45.5. The only admin binding is cluster-admin to Group system:masters, which looks like a platform default.", "targets": ["goat"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 7, "failed": 14, "skipped": 5, "score": 38}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 8, "failed": 11, "skipped": 5, "score": 45.5}], "findings": [{"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Privileged containers with hostPath mounts (debug-shell, node-agent)", "resource": "default/Deployment/debug-shell; prod/DaemonSet/node-agent", "controls": ["C-0057", "C-0048", "KSV-0017", "KSV-0023", "PSS 3", "PSS 5"], "evidence": "Kubescape, Trivy misconfig and Trivy PSS all flag 2 resources as privileged and as mounting hostPath volumes.", "fix": "Set securityContext.privileged: false, drop the hostPath volumes (or use readOnly with a narrow path), and remove debug-shell from the cluster if it is not needed: kubectl -n default delete deploy debug-shell. For node-agent, confirm host access is required and grant only the specific capabilities it needs."}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "OpenSSL CVE-2025-90001 in debug-shell image", "resource": "default/Deployment/debug-shell", "controls": ["CVE-2025-90001"], "evidence": "Trivy reports openssl 3.0.1 installed, HIGH severity, fixed in 3.0.9. Trivy's cluster totals are 3 HIGH and 10 MEDIUM vulnerabilities, but only this HIGH is itemised.", "fix": "Rebuild the image with openssl >= 3.0.9 (for example by updating the base image), or remove the workload."}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Privilege escalation allowed and containers may run as root", "resource": "default/Deployment/debug-shell (examples); 5 and 9 resources respectively", "controls": ["C-0016", "C-0013"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0016 fails on 5 resources and C-0013 on 9, with debug-shell as the example for both.", "fix": "securityContext: {allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 10001}"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Cluster-admin bound to system:masters", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin", "controls": [], "evidence": "The only admin binding in rbac_and_argo is cluster-admin for Group system:masters, which looks like a platform default. The digest shows no wildcard custom roles.", "fix": "No change needed. Keep membership of system:masters restricted and avoid issuing client certificates in that group."}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Writable container root filesystems", "resource": "default/Deployment/web (example); 12 resources", "controls": ["C-0017"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0017 fails on 12 resources.", "fix": "securityContext: {readOnlyRootFilesystem: true}, with emptyDir volumes for any paths that need writes."}], "not_checked": [{"item": "node and control-plane CIS checks", "reason": "need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"}, {"item": "git history", "reason": "secrets removed from history are not scanned"}, {"item": "remaining MEDIUM vulnerabilities and non-example resources", "reason": "the digest lists only one HIGH CVE and example resources, not the full lists"}, {"item": "Argo CD configuration", "reason": "the digest shows no Argo data beyond the admin bindings"}]}
